# Green Woody Home
> Private eco-friendly villa in Castel di Decima, Rome countryside: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 120 m² living space, 1,500 m² private garden, fully solar-powered. About 30 minutes from central Rome and 15 minutes from the sea (Torvaianica). Sleeps up to 8 guests.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/): Overview of the villa, points of interest and distances
- [Gallery](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/gallery): Photos of bedrooms, bathrooms, living room, kitchen and garden
- [Services](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/services): Amenities (Wi-Fi, parking, EV charger, air conditioning) and local experiences
- [Reservations](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/reservations): Direct booking request and availability calendar

- Address: Via Clarice Tartufari, Castel di Decima, 00128 Rome, Italy
